proposition: The only date in the entry for the R. fī Sharḥ Ḥaqīqat al-Waḥda is the MS Majlis 10196 copy date of 3 Dhū l-Ḥijja 827 (27 October 1424), the same day as the Sharḥ-i Ḥadīs-i ʿAmāʾ; the entry gives no composition date, and the folio range printed overlaps that of the ʿAmāʾ commentary (f. 120a-20b against ff. 119b-20b).

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
